summary: Keep explicit lifecycle date labels paired with their own cited dates in project answers.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
An offline reproduction proved that full-date grounding accepted an issued date as the due date when both dates occurred in one citation
approval_evidence: The persistent RFI, Submittal and Email objective authorizes this deterministic answer-accuracy improvement.
known_limitations: The guard recognizes a bounded English lifecycle-date vocabulary rather than arbitrary semantic date labels.
A date role must be immediately associated with the date or be the only date role in a one-date sentence; complex respectively-style prose fails conservatively.
Multiple dates for one claimed role remain ambiguous; the guard does not order events or infer current status.
The guard does not prove that every relevant project document was uploaded or parsed.
